cisceNodes: c3_bio_001 (Living and non-living things), c3_bio_002 (Internal organs of the human body), c3_bio_003 (Respiratory system organs), c3_bio_004 (Process of breathing - inhale and exhale), c3_bio_005 (Air pollution and breathing problems)
mascotDescription: a friendly doctor with a white coat, stethoscope, glasses, and a clipboard. Custom SVG, not an owl.
sceneDescription: hospital garden scene with sky gradient, hospital building, trees, a bench, and a skeleton model showing organs
challengeTypes: identify: Which of these is a LIVING thing? (A plant that grows vs A stone that stays the same vs A chair that gets old)
identify: Which is a feature of ALL living things? (They grow on their own vs They are made of wood vs They never change)
sort: Drag each thing to Living or Non-Living (Living: plant, dog, bird, fish, human | Non-Living: stone, chair, fan, book, water)
identify: Which internal organ pumps blood to the whole body? (Heart vs Lungs vs Stomach)
sort: Drag each organ to its correct function (Heart: pumps blood | Lungs: breathe air | Stomach: digest food | Brain: thinking and control | Liver: cleaning blood | Kidney: removing waste)
identify: When we breathe IN (inhale), what happens? (Chest expands, air goes into lungs vs Chest shrinks, air goes out vs We stop breathing)
sort: Drag the breathing steps in order (1. Air enters nose | 2. Air goes down windpipe | 3. Air reaches lungs | 4. Lungs take in oxygen | 5. We breathe out carbon dioxide)

sort: Drag each item to Cause of Air Pollution or Way to Protect (Pollution: factory smoke, vehicle exhaust, burning garbage, firecrackers | Protect: wear mask, plant trees, use clean fuel, avoid burning waste)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Living and non-living things — living things grow, need food and water, breathe, move on their own, reproduce, and die. Non-living things do not. Movement alone does not mean living (fan moves but is not living). (2) Internal organs — heart (pumps blood), lungs (breathe air), stomach (digests food), brain (thinking and control), liver (cleans blood), kidneys (remove waste). (3) Respiratory system — nose, windpipe (trachea), lungs. Air enters nose, goes down windpipe, reaches lungs. Lungs take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide. (4) Process of breathing — inhale: chest expands, air goes in, lungs fill up. Exhale: chest shrinks, air goes out, lungs empty. We breathe about 20 times per minute. (5) Air pollution and breathing problems — smoke from factories and vehicles, dust, burning garbage, firecrackers all pollute air. Polluted air causes coughing, asthma, and lung diseases. Ways to protect: wear a mask in dusty areas, plant trees, use clean fuel, do not burn waste. Misconceptions: 'if something moves it is living' (fan moves but is not living — living things move on their own), 'we breathe only oxygen' (we breathe in air which has oxygen, we breathe out carbon dioxide), 'heart is for breathing' (heart pumps blood, lungs are for breathing), 'stomach cleans blood' (liver cleans blood, stomach digests food). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function LivingThingsGame), NOT export default. Export interface LivingThingsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
